tools.name: list_products
tools.description: The Aruon Beacon products offered today, with their prices in US dollars before tax (5% Texas sales tax on SaaS is added at checkout), each orderable one's crypto total, and the payment rails accepted now. Other products are quoted by a person: see https://beacon.aruon.ai/pricing.json.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Records an order request for a website's owner (the principal). Nothing is charged. While crypto is open for the contact_email, rail usdc_base answers an order_token, and no operator key is needed: start_crypto_payment is next. Otherwise, with a crypto rail, an approved operator gets a crypto quote

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Whether Beacon can score a website and install on it, from the published platform list and Beacon's address rules. Nothing is fetched in this call: what can only be known from the site itself is answered "we will check it when we score it".

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: With the order_token create_order gave: this order's status and its crypto block. Or with order_id and operator_key, for the operator whose key made the order: pending_review while a person has not approved the operator, else the payment service's order view (held and why, quoted and the quote, paid

tools.name: start_crypto_payment
tools.description: For an order token from create_order: files the payment details (rail usdc_base, billing address with a two-letter state for the US, the wallet the buyer pays from, role, acceptance) and Beacon emails a one-time code to the buyer's own inbox (the order's email address), never to the agent. Answers t

tools.name: confirm_crypto_payment
tools.description: For the code the buyer received: answers the quote, or the hold and who must act. The quote is an exact amount (price, 5% Texas sales tax and a small unique tail), a receive address and a 20-minute window to send it, from the wallet declared. The agent never pays: the buyer sends from their own wall

tools.name: request_new_quote
tools.description: For an order token whose quote has expired: a fresh 20-minute quote, and the order's status read again.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_order, confirm_crypto_payment · Private data: create_order, start_crypto_payment, confirm_crypto_payment, request_new_quote · Public sink: create_order, start_crypto_payment, confirm_crypto_payment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_order, confirm_crypto_payment · Private data: create_order, start_crypto_payment, confirm_crypto_payment, request_new_quote · Public sink: create_order, start_crypto_payment, confirm_crypto_payment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
